message:
The other day, as the weather forecast warned of a looming storm, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter sent a flurry of emoji-laden messages, asking if I had enough candles, and my son chimed in with a meme about stocking up on snacks—clearly the most important part of storm prep, right? It was a little chaotic, but it made me smile to see everyone rallying around this shared concern, even if it was through their screens.

I took a moment to share my own tips, like checking the flashlights and filling up the bathtub with water (who knew it could double as a mini swimming pool for the grandkids?). In the end, we all felt a bit more connected, ready to weather whatever came our way together. 

What funny or useful tips do you have for staying prepared during a storm? 🌧️
